name: TrueNAS Apps Watcher
author: David Boulay
description: Watches a TrueNAS SCALE server for pending app upgrades and newer container images — and, through Portainer, for updates to the containers TrueNAS doesn't manage — and applies them from the bar.

barWidget.description: Pending TrueNAS app updates with versions, one-click apply with live job progress, and optional Portainer container watching.

schema.label: Check interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often to re-read TrueNAS's installed apps in the background.

schema.label: Container check interval (hours)
schema.description: How often to ask the registries whether unmanaged containers have a newer image. One round trip per unique image, and a tag moves on the order of days, so keep this well above the app interval.

schema.label: Hide the widget when everything is up to date
schema.description: Keeps the bar clear until something actually needs updating.
